svg.text: onda, Cmajor, YDSP and C++ against the best Faust build
Speed relative to the fastest Faust build of the same contract (the ×1 line): up, faster than Faust; down, slower. Log scale.
Strict IEEEgeometric means: onda ×0.93 · Cmajor ×0.70 · YDSP ×0.63 · C++ ×0.94
fast-mathgeometric means: onda ×0.77 · Cmajor ×0.59 · YDSP ×0.59 · C++ ×0.83
Cmajor: the faster of its generated C++ and its LLVM JIT. YDSP: YUP's JIT. C++: hand-written port, clang. Apple M5,
f32, 48 kHz, 256-frame blocks; means over 38 programs. Programs grouped by category; columns past ×⅛ are cut at the axis.
